name: EPIC 205114411
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 16.4 solar radii and 1.07 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205114411 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.427137 (16th-84th percentiles 15.428963-17.508226), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,360 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 1.07 solar masses and 16.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,580 K at its surface.
